reviewDispositions.rationale: The full mapped screening performance is now taught and assessed inside the pack. lesson.json adds objective-screening-natural-frequencies; scenes 1, 4, 5, and 7 introduce and practise natural-frequency Bayes reasoning plus sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value, and negative predictive value; assessment.json adds four numerical calculations from an unseen table; and claims.json, glossary.json, references.json, and ATTRIBUTION.md were aligned to those changes.

content/04-inverted-conditional.md and content/08-clinical-wrap-up.md no longer present 0.029 as an unexplained study result. They now use an explicitly hypothetical p value of about 0.03 only to distinguish a probability computed under a hypothesis from a probability of the hypothesis, and state that it is not computed from the counts supplied in this lesson.

assessment.json now consistently requires both prevalence and the positive-result rate among people without the condition, or equivalent specificity information, in the screening-inversion answer summary, reasoning, acceptable response, and rubric. The new numerical screening items also require learners to calculate the relevant true-state and result-conditioned measures rather than rely on verbal recognition.

It uses the scoped description that the distinction is what the lesson is built around, and the revised scope paragraph states the actual screening performance taught without ranking it against every other idea.
